# arianet_load_balancer (Resource)

A load balancer. Maps to `/cloud/v1/load-balancers` (`change_type`, `change_algorithm`, `attach_to_network`/`detach_from_network` actions). Listeners and targets are separate resources: `arianet_load_balancer_service` and `arianet_load_balancer_target`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "arianet_load_balancer" "lb" {
  name       = "web"
  datacenter = "eu-central-1"
  type       = "lb11"
  algorithm  = "round_robin"
  network_id = arianet_network.private.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `datacenter` (String) Datacenter code. Changing it replaces the load balancer.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `type` (String) Load balancer type code, e.g. `lb11` (see `arianet_load_balancer_types`). Changing it resizes in place.

### Optional

- `algorithm` (String) `round_robin` or `least_connections`.
- `labels` (Map of String) User-defined labels (key/value pairs). Lists can be filtered by them with a label selector.
- `network_id` (Number) Private network the load balancer is attached to (needed for targets with `use_private_ip`).
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project the resource is in. Defaults to the account's default project; changing it moves the resource.
- `protection_delete` (Boolean) Whether the resource is protected from deletion. Must be set to false before the resource can be destroyed.
- `public_interface` (Boolean) Whether the load balancer has public addresses. Changing it replaces the load balancer.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Load balancer ID.
- `ipv4` (String) Public IPv4 address.
- `ipv6` (String) Public IPv6 address.
- `private_ip` (String) Address in the private network.
- `status` (String) Status.

- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import arianet_load_balancer.lb 21
```
